Hush Rules

A tab is muted when its URL matches any enabled rule. Only http:// and https:// pages are checked. Muting happens as soon as the tab's URL is known, so a very short burst of audio at the start of a page load is possible.

Click the Hush Rules toolbar button to mute or unmute the current tab. A manual choice is kept until the page reloads or navigates to a new page.

Open tabs

Mute a tab manually or add its domain as a rule.

    No open http:// or https:// tabs.

    Add a rule

    Enter a hostname such as example.com, or paste a full http(s) URL and its hostname will be used. example.com matches only example.com unless “Include subdomains” is on (then it also matches www.example.com, a.example.com, …). It never matches notexample.com or example.com.evil.test.
    Enter a complete URL starting with http:// or https://. The scheme, host and port must match exactly; then the path must start with the given path (case-sensitive). Query strings (?…) and fragments (#…) are ignored. https://example.com/news matches /news, /news/123 and also /newsletter; enter https://example.com/news/ to match only pages inside the /news/ directory.
